text: Taking the already-closed incident upstairs to Denise Okafor, Thomas Reyes, and Priya Nair -- honestly, not defensively.
What's already live and working: Sentinel and Defender XDR watching the tenant, Conditional Access enforcing MFA, and zero-trust segmentation that actually contained this incident.
The exact mechanism, named precisely: credential reuse against the Vantage Core Systems vendor portal, an interactive sign-in from Romania, and two documented exclusions that both let it through.
The honest number: detection took about 36 hours against a committed 4-hour target -- a real miss this project had already flagged as a possibility, in writing, months earlier.
Next: formally closing the risk-register entry with the cost-versus-risk case for the record.
